values.intro: You do not need a studio, a label or a lot of money to get your music heard. This path takes you from recording on a phone or laptop to having your song on Spotify, Apple Music and Audiomack, and then to understanding the people who listen.
values.promise: From idea to released song, and the first thousand listeners

done: You have one finished mix
You can export a WAV file
You have listened to it on phone speakers, earbuds and a car or home system
stages.goal: Record a song that sounds clean on phone speakers and earbuds

steps.first_win: Record a 60-second idea and send it to one friend
steps.what: Record vocals and instruments in the browser or app, then share a rough demo with collaborators
Clean up noise, trim and normalise a vocal take
Move to a full desktop studio when you outgrow phone apps: tracks, plugins, mixing
If you have a Mac, iPhone or iPad: loops, drums and quick songwriting

stages.title: Capture your sound

done: You have a lead sheet for one song
Your band or choir can read it
stages.goal: Notate songs so other musicians can play them

steps.first_win: Notate the chorus of your song
steps.what: Write a lead sheet or choir parts and export a PDF

stages.title: Write it down

done: Your song is live on at least one store
Your artist name matches everywhere
You know the release date, ISRC and who gets paid
stages.goal: Put your song on every major streaming service

steps.what: Upload your track, artwork and details to many stores at once

steps.first_win: Compare two distributors in a table
steps.what: The alternative distributor: compare how each one pays and charges before you commit
Reach African and Caribbean audiences, upload directly and understand its creator tools

steps.first_win: Check whether release is available in your country
steps.what: Release straight from the app if you recorded there

stages.title: Get it released

done: You have a recognisable cover style
You have 3 short clips ready for release week
stages.goal: Make cover art and short videos that people stop to watch

steps.first_win: Make one cover with the correct size
steps.what: Design square cover art and a Spotify Canvas-style visual
Cut 15 to 30 second clips with your lyrics on screen

steps.first_win: Post a Reel with a link to your song
steps.what: Use Reels and Stories to tell the story behind the song

stages.title: Look the part

done: You can say which song and which post worked best
You plan the next release from evidence
stages.goal: Know who listens, where, and what works

steps.what: Claim your profile, update your photo and bio, pitch a new song to editors, read the numbers

steps.first_win: Note your top song and top city
steps.what: Read your plays and followers by song
Keep a simple release log: date, platform, plays, what you posted

stages.title: Understand your listeners

done: You know your income and costs this month
You can answer a booking enquiry in five minutes
stages.goal: Keep your money, contracts and fans organised

steps.what: A catalogue and quick replies for show bookings and merch
Record show fees, royalties and costs
Draft bios, press notes and booking emails, then edit them in your own voice

stages.title: Run your music as a business

values.title: The Musician Helper

values.intro: Analysts earn trust by answering real questions with clean data and clear charts. This path takes you from solid spreadsheets, through cleaning and SQL, to dashboards and your first notebook, with AI as a checking partner and not a shortcut.
values.promise: From messy spreadsheets to dashboards people act on

done: You can explain every formula in your file
A colleague can reopen your work without you
stages.goal: Build formulas, tables and charts that others can follow

steps.first_win: Summarise a sales file with a pivot table
steps.what: Tables, lookups, pivot tables and charts on a real dataset
Share and collaborate, and import data from other sheets

stages.title: Spreadsheets you can trust

done: You keep the raw file untouched
Your cleaning steps can be run again
stages.goal: Turn messy exports into tidy tables you can analyse

steps.first_win: Clean a monthly export in one click
steps.what: Split columns, fix types, merge files and repeat the steps next month

steps.first_win: Load a CSV and count missing values
steps.what: Use pandas when files are too large or messy for a spreadsheet

stages.title: Clean the data

done: You can use SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, JOIN
You can explain what each query returns
stages.goal: Pull exactly the data you need from a database

steps.what: Connect to a database, browse tables and run queries
Practise on large public datasets in the cloud

stages.title: Ask questions with SQL

done: Each dashboard answers one question
Titles state the finding, not the topic
stages.goal: Build dashboards and charts that lead to decisions

steps.what: Model data, write measures and build a report with filters

steps.first_win: Connect a sheet and share a report
steps.what: A free web option, good for marketing and Google data
Make clear, accessible charts and maps for reports and articles

stages.title: Show it clearly

done: Someone else can rerun your notebook
You state what your result does not show
stages.goal: Explore data, test ideas and share a reproducible analysis

steps.first_win: Share a notebook that runs top to bottom
steps.what: Explore, chart and explain in one notebook

steps.first_win: Open a notebook and run it
steps.what: Run notebooks in the browser with nothing to install

steps.first_win: Compare two groups and explain the difference
steps.what: Summaries, group comparisons, simple models

stages.title: Go deeper with notebooks

done: You never ship numbers you have not checked
You can say what the AI helped with
stages.goal: Speed up the work without losing accuracy

steps.first_win: Ask for a query then verify it on a small sample
steps.what: Explain errors, draft SQL and formulas, and suggest checks

steps.first_win: Ask it to find holes in your method
steps.what: Review your analysis for gaps and summarise findings in plain words

stages.title: Work with AI, carefully

done: You have three projects with the question, the data and the finding
stages.goal: Build a portfolio and tell the story

steps.first_win: Post one project with the question, method and result
steps.what: Publish case studies and share your dashboards

stages.title: Show your work

values.title: The Data Analyst Helper

values.intro: Starting something is mostly about finding out whether people want it, then keeping the simple things in order. This path takes you from testing an idea to selling, keeping books, growing and pitching, using tools that cost little or nothing at the start.
values.promise: From idea to first paying customers, and a business you can run

done: You have spoken to 20 potential customers
You know who would pay, how much and why
stages.goal: Find out whether real people would pay

steps.first_win: Compare three names for your idea
steps.what: See how interest in your idea changes over time and by place

steps.first_win: Send a survey and collect 20 replies
steps.what: Ask 20 people the same five questions and read the answers
A free option for quick surveys
Brainstorm questions, spot weak assumptions and summarise answers. It does not replace talking to customers

stages.title: Test the idea

done: You can state your customer, offer, price and first goal in four sentences
stages.goal: Put the idea, money and next steps on a page

steps.what: Keep your plan, tasks and notes in one place

steps.first_win: Fill in a business model canvas
steps.what: Map your customers, offer and channels on a canvas

steps.first_win: Calculate how many sales you need each month
steps.what: Estimate costs, prices and break-even

stages.title: Make a plan you can use

done: A stranger can tell what you sell in five seconds
stages.goal: Have a name, look and place people can find you

steps.first_win: Create a logo and three post templates
steps.what: A simple logo, colours and templates
Appear on Google Maps and in local search
Build a simple website when you are ready for one

stages.title: Look credible

done: You have been paid by at least three customers
You can take an order and a payment end to end
stages.goal: Get your first paying customers

steps.what: Catalogue, labels, quick replies and broadcast lists
Show your work and answer questions in direct messages
Sell digital products and courses with local payments

steps.first_win: Compare it with Selar before you decide
steps.what: A full online shop when you have steady orders
Take card and bank payments

steps.first_win: Compare two providers in a table
steps.what: An alternative payment provider; compare fees and countries

stages.title: Sell

done: You know this month's sales, costs and profit
You keep business money apart from personal money
stages.goal: Know whether you are making a profit

steps.what: Free invoicing and basic accounting
A fuller accounting package for growing businesses

steps.first_win: Record this week's sales and costs
steps.what: A simple weekly sales and costs sheet

stages.title: Keep the money straight

done: You hear from past customers regularly
You know where your best customers come from
stages.goal: Bring back customers and find new ones

steps.what: Collect emails and send a monthly update

steps.first_win: Update your headline to say what you do
steps.what: Meet partners, suppliers and hires
Track leads and follow-ups when WhatsApp is not enough

stages.title: Grow

done: You can pitch in three minutes
You know what you are asking for and why
stages.goal: Explain your business clearly to people with money

steps.first_win: Build a pitch with the problem, solution, market, traction and ask
steps.what: A clear 10-slide pitch
Design the deck so it is easy to read
Practise hard investor questions

stages.title: Pitch and raise

values.title: The Entrepreneur Helper
